observation.visible_scene: Two upright diamond rings stand on a white sheet printed with rows of text/numbers, set against a dark background on which the rings cast a shadow. Bright star‑shaped glints sparkle off the stones and the metal throughout.
visible_changes: At the start the two rings overlap into a single silhouette (one band circle with one stone head); as the viewing angle changes across the clip they resolve into two distinct upright rings standing side by side, the right‑hand ring showing a small‑stone (pavé) band while the left shows a plain band.
The cast shadow on the dark background transitions from a single loop to two loops and continuously shifts position and shape.
The printed text on the paper moves across the frame and tilts in‑plane.
Starburst reflections wander across the stones and the band as the angle changes.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the changing view is produced by a camera orbiting the rings or by the paper/rings rotating on a turntable is not determinable from the excerpt.
Any motion before the first frame or after the last frame is unseen.
uncertain_details: Exact cause of the apparent rotation (camera motion vs. object/platform motion).
Precise cut and setting style of each ring beyond what is visible.
